details.description: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe is Google's speech-to-text model, built on Gemini's audio understanding, for converting uploaded audio files into text. It offers automatic language detection across 85+ languages with mid-session code-switching, speaker diarization for up to 8 speakers, word-level timestamps, and custom-vocabulary biasing for domain-specific terms, plus a 'Smart transcription' mode that removes filler words and applies intent-aware formatting, per its Gemini API model page. It is generally available, last updated August 2026, and processes audio files up to 1 hour long (up to 30 minutes when diarization or word-level timestamps are enabled).
advantages: Automatically detects 85+ languages, including mid-session code-switching, per its Gemini API model page.
Supports speaker diarization for up to 8 speakers, per its Gemini API model page.
Supports word-level timestamps, per its Gemini API model page.
Accepts custom vocabulary biasing of up to 1,000 domain-specific terms, per its Gemini API model page.
Supports audio files up to 1 hour long per request, per its Gemini API model page.
disadvantages: Word-level timestamps and speaker diarization are incompatible with custom vocabulary and reduce the maximum processed audio to 30 minutes, per its Gemini API model page.
Attribution for 3 or more simultaneous speakers is described as experimental, per its Gemini API model page.
Does not support the Batch API, per its Gemini API model page.
use_cases: Transcribing audio files with speaker attribution and word-level timing, per its Gemini API model page.
Generating searchable transcripts adapted to specialized or domain-specific terminology via custom vocabulary, per its Gemini API model page.
Multilingual transcription with automatic language and code-switching detection, per its Gemini API model page.

notes: The catalog lists 'text_input' among this model's modalities, but its Gemini API model page describes inputs as audio only (up to 1 hour) with text output; I could not confirm a text-input capability on the pages I opened, so I kept the catalog's value and flag the disagreement here. No WER or other accuracy figures were published on the pages opened, so evaluations are left empty. This is the file-based transcription endpoint; the real-time gemini-3.5-transcribe-live variant lacks diarization and word-level timestamps.
